units.source_text: 后来大公主写信给二公主了。

en.t: Later, the Elder Princess wrote a letter to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了大公主的手笔，觉得异常秀美，心中不胜欣喜，

en.t: General Kaoru saw the Elder Princess's handwriting and found it extraordinarily elegant and beautiful, filling his heart with delight,

units.source_text: 悔不早点叫她们通信，早点欣赏这手笔。

en.t: and he regretted not having had them exchange letters sooner, so that he might have admired this handwriting earlier.

units.source_text: 明石皇后也送了二公主许多美丽的图画。

en.t: Empress Akashi also sent the Second Princess many beautiful pictures.

units.source_text: 薰大将收集许多更美丽的图画，赠送大公主。

en.t: General Kaoru collected many still more beautiful pictures and presented them to the Elder Princess.

units.source_text: 其中有一幅画的是《芹川大将物语》中的情景：

en.t: Among them was one painting that depicted a scene from The Tale of General Serikawa:

units.source_text: 远君恋慕大公主，有一个秋天的傍晚，

en.t: Tokimi longed for the Elder Princess, and one autumn evening,

units.source_text: 不堪相思之苦，走进大公主室中去。

en.t: unable to endure the pain of love, he went into the Elder Princess's room.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了，觉得这远君很像是替自己写照，

en.t: When General Kaoru saw it, he felt that this Tokimi seemed very much like a portrait of himself,

units.source_text: 他想：“我的大公主能像画中的大公主那样爱我才好。”

en.t: and he thought, "If only my Elder Princess would love me as the Elder Princess in the painting does."

units.source_text: 便悲叹自己命苦，赋诗曰：

en.t: Then he lamented his own bitter fate and composed this poem:
